data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 shares mechanism with SRC_001: both compute the complement (numbers with at least one repeated digit) using inclusion-exclusion over pairs of positions, differing only in partition algebra (SRC_003 sums singles 270, subtracts doubles 27, adds triple 9; SRC_001 partitions AAB/ABA/BAA then corrects AAA) to arrive at the same 252 complement. It is refuted if either SRC_003's PIE or SRC_001's partition does not yield exactly 252 for the repeated-digit set, or if the union of repeated-digit events is not correctly modeled by pairwise position-equality sets.
